title: Map PR1048 arithmetic repairs and remaining transport review
body:

Add one focused correction map and link it from that paragraph. The note gives the concrete next review or integration step for each gap, with exact heads, source hashes, a source-status receipt, and predecessor credit. It changes no historical package, review disposition, selected result or mathematical theorem.

The selected source-binding baseline, original PR1048 counterexample and PR1182 independent integer separation pass under Python 3.12.7. A separate AI reviewer checked the map against the exact source scopes and counts with no blocker. Neither full transport census nor the selected cold replay was rerun for this documentation change.

Task `scope-navigation`, priority revision 4, nonce `bf817d4fc3510cbd4d68862bdf57cfaa`; base and final refreshed canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. This is a narrow navigation contribution, not a new mathematical result. Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI review; no independent human review is claimed.
